title: Normalized clopen tensor comparison data
statement: For either Mode of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], use the Cartesian proper/open geometry of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus] and the ringed-site derived module and tensor models of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Define PullTensor by an ordinary tensor isomorphism satisfying the pure-unit formula, preservation of resolving complexes, and a derived tensor isomorphism satisfying the signed-total representative equation. Define OpenTensor by restriction on pure sections and its open-adjunction inverse transpose. For Operations o and an open s into its upper-left corner, Data consists of two PullTensor records, the two OpenTensor records, an exact extension of s with reverse adjunction whose counit is inverse to its open unit, and a composite tensor isomorphism normalized under the composite adjunction. Define rho as the localized reverse unit, alpha as beta followed by extension of rho, and Equations as the Cartesian, clopen, composite-open and pasted tensor equalities. The complete field formulas are the literal unchanged definitions in the attached Lean module. The sequence-site interpretation is [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]; no derived category, coefficient ring, or object condition is changed.
